headline: PBOC Raises Foreign Exchange Deposit Reserve Requirement Ratio
summary: The People's Bank of China announced it will raise the reserve requirement ratio on foreign exchange deposits by 2 percentage points to 6 per cent effective November 15.
why: Changes to foreign exchange deposit reserve requirements are tools used by central banks to manage banking sector liquidity and influence currency values.
why_moved: Adjustments to bank reserve requirements alter domestic liquidity conditions and foreign exchange market flows.
